files.README.md:
# Mireside Haulage - trunk legs

Shared folder for the traffic office.

- runs/  cards for each leg and trip
- fuel/  bunker notes from the depot

turns.prompt: A traffic planner new to Mireside Haulage asked what a tonne-kilometre is on a leg card; it is one tonne carried one kilometre, so a leg's work is its payload times the distance it runs. Leg LG-77 ran 146 kilometres with 18.4 tonnes aboard. Give the work the leg did, as a single number in tonne-kilometres with no unit in the reply. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
